title: Thrust Reverser Translating Sleeve — Removal of the Aft Seal and Heat Shield
abstract: Shop removal of the aft seal and the heat shield from a thrust reverser translating sleeve, with the liner condition survey that determines whether the sleeve can be converted at all.

sections.purpose: This task gives the shop procedure to remove the aft seal and the heat shield from a translating sleeve, and the inner liner condition survey that must be recorded before any further work is done.
sections.job_setup_note: The sleeve is mounted in the shop stand for this task; it must not be attempted on wing. The liner survey is the deciding step: a sleeve with delamination beyond the allowable limits must go to repair before it is converted, and the survey result governs that. The seal carrier fasteners are single use. The heat shield is thin and distorts easily if it is levered rather than lifted square.
sections.procedure: 1. Mount the sleeve in the shop stand and confirm it is level. 2. Clean the aft seal area and the liner face with the approved solvent. WARNING: USE THE APPROVED SOLVENT ONLY AND WORK WITH EXTRACTION RUNNING. THE DEPOSITS ON A SCORCHED LINER RELEASE IRRITANT VAPOUR WHEN SOLVENT IS APPLIED. 3. Do the inner liner condition survey over the full circumference, recording the extent of any scorching and any delamination against the allowable limits. 4. Photograph any area beyond limits and record the station. 5. Remove the heat shield retaining fasteners in the sequence given in the figure. 6. Lift the heat shield square off the sleeve. CAUTION: DO NOT LEVER THE HEAT SHIELD. IT IS THIN AND A LEVERED CORNER DISTORTS PERMANENTLY. 7. Remove the aft seal retaining fasteners and discard them. 8. Remove the aft seal and its carrier where fitted. 9. Measure and record the seal groove or land dimension at the four stations given in the figure. 10. Examine the blocker door land for scoring and record the condition. 11. Blank the exposed fastener holes.
sections.close_out: Record the liner survey result, the four land or groove measurements and the blocker door land condition in the reverser record. Where the liner survey is beyond limits, route the sleeve to repair and do not continue to the installation task. Retain the survey photographs with the shop package.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The land measurement at step 9 uses the pre-conversion datum on aircraft pre MOD-149010.

safety_precautions: Use the approved solvent only and work with extraction running.
Confirm the sleeve is secure in the shop stand before work starts.
Wear eye and respiratory protection during liner cleaning.
